game_concept: A action puzzle set in The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse, the fortified castle gatehouse: the knight must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Castle Gatehouse: the fortified castle gatehouse
core_gameplay_loop: In Castle Gatehouse, repeat each round: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it. Each round, a new grain sacks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the wave_target value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of grain sacks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Reassign Relay
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Castle Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Castle Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
